name: Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.3)
author: Darius Cumpio
announcement: Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.3) — Unified Full-Stack Apache 2.4 + PHP 8.x + MySQL / MariaDB (:3306) Release! Includes standalone DariusDB-Updater.exe, GitHub Release & Private Repo Token support, Installer/Launcher/Uninstaller/Updater executables on GitHub, 5th-Picture Toggle-Switch Dashboard, and MySQL Error 1130 + sqlcmd.exe auto-provisioning fixes.
changelog: Added standalone DariusDB-Updater.exe (Win32 GUI & CLI) and bundled Installer, Launcher, Uninstaller & Updater in GitHub
Fixed System Version Updater GitHub fetch diagnostics (Private repo HTTP 404 detection + optional GitHub Token + 1-Click GitHub Release auto-download)
Fixed MySQL Error 1130 on 127.0.0.1, removed username/password from mssql.conf, and auto-provisioned sqlcmd.exe
Separated MariaDB and MySQL into individual rows and tabs across Dashboard, Database, Versions, Config & Logs, and Settings
Redesigned Services Dashboard with 5th-picture Toggle-Switch rows and interactive Full-Stack Architecture guide
Hardened PHP (Zend OPcache, PDO utf8mb4, secure sessions), Apache security headers, and MariaDB/MySQL InnoDB 256M configs
Fixed Apache 2.4.66 portable provisioning when upstream mirrors return HTML redirects
